steinberger.en: Open source agents are the alternative to lab agents—model-agnostic and everywhere—yet financially unsustainable, losing $10-20k monthly.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体是实验室智能体的替代方案——不绑定模型、随处运行——但财务上不可持续，每月亏损一两万美元。

steinberger.en: The real bottleneck is compute and tokens, not model intelligence; model capability doesn't degrade—projects just get messier over time.
steinberger.zh: 真正的瓶颈是算力与 token，而非模型智能；模型能力不会退化——只是项目随时间变得越发混乱。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10 to 100 times.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一系列权衡——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization, yet calibrated quantization can still win on cost and speed.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与推测解码是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化，但经过校准的量化仍能在成本与速度上取胜。

philipkiely.en: The field is shifting from kernel writing toward infrastructure orchestration as GPUs become more specialized, with disaggregated prefill and decode and KV cache management central.
philipkiely.zh: 随着 GPU 日益专用化，该领域正从内核编写转向基础设施编排，分离式预填充与解码以及 KV 缓存管理成为核心。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; human accountability remains essential—'can't vibe code uptime'.
philipkiely.zh: 通过量化感知训练与蒸馏，推理工程正与训练融合；人的责任仍不可或缺——‘不能靠感觉写可用性’。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier models belong to hyperscalers, startups should build domain agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调应用层 AI 的核心是智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导，创业公司应深耕垂直领域的智能体。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token usage is not value, business outcomes are.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从写代码变为操作代码生成机器；token 消耗不是价值，业务结果才是。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; responsible iterative deployment—make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8—is the path to safety.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 让专业知识民主化；负责任地迭代部署——在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全——才是通往安全的路径。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI expands markets via Jevons paradox; specialized vendors, not just model providers, will drive innovation.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他认为应用层 AI 借杰文斯悖论扩大市场；创新将来自专业厂商，而不只是模型提供方。

brettaylor.en: Agents already outperform him at coding, elevating the role; AI creates more jobs than it displaces, though the pace causes discomfort.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他坦言智能体在编程上已超过自己，但这提升了人的角色；AI 创造的岗位多于取代的岗位，尽管节奏令人不适。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should tinker, follow curiosity, and leave individual fingerprints rather than acting as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调浏览器设计必须靠原型驱动：设计师应动手试错、追随好奇心，在产品上留下个人印记，而非始终作为整齐划一的团队行动。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products remains crucial; balancing intuition and data, with vision guiding final design decisions.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终认为给浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性至关重要，并坚持在直觉与数据之间平衡，让愿景引导最终设计。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project prototyping Claude Code interfaces; rich context and prescriptive prompts yield good results.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向 AI 设计工具：Claude Design 始于一人副业，通过给 Claude Code 界面做原型起步；提供丰富上下文和明确指令才能获得好结果。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出，随着工程实现变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；设计师应用 Claude Code 做生产软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste, so ask for volume of options; being uncomfortably early matters more than polishing, and humans still monopolize good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：模型尚无好品味，应要求大量选项；在 AI 时代，过早行动比打磨更重要，而人类仍垄断好的设计想法，模型更擅长杂活而非设计思考。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL-based post-training break the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此在原型开发中用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Post-training stays subjective: human judgment and diverse benchmarks are needed to capture creativity and emotional intelligence beyond fixed tests.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化了后训练是主观的判断：需要人类判断与多元基准来捕捉创造力与情商，而非固定测试。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must be continuous rather than fixed to keep pace with model capability.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿智能体日益擅长奖励黑客，因此基准必须持续演进而非固定，才能跟上模型能力。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张把单一模型服务数十亿人会收敛为平均声音，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具，把个人风格写进 design.md，从参考出发迭代，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you must supply a giant prompt with context and design system to exploit superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身不会变得更聪明；必须提供带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词，才能用好超级智能模型。

mengto.en: He now writes 0% of the code; AI writes everything, so precise communication and curiosity about workflow matter more than syntax.
mengto.zh: 他现在 0% 的代码自己写，全由 AI 完成，因此精准沟通与对工作流的持续好奇比语法更重要。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams—so ship imperfect work now.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生最大的技术机会，让一人完成过去一个团队的事——所以现在就发布不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; VC is a trap, and perfectionism is fear in disguise.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵问题；风投是陷阱，完美主义是伪装的恐惧。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: as everyone becomes a model manager, management skills and generalists gain value.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 会推动就业回流，并带来“分配经济”：人人都成为模型管理者，管理能力与通才因此升值。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: when running agents indefinitely becomes profitable, not by passing tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他主张用经济标准定义 AGI（通用人工智能）：当无限期运行智能体变得有利可图时才算 AGI，而非通过图灵测试。

danshipper.en: Agents need caring human oversight; the job apocalypse is a lie, and PMs and designers who ship with AI thrive.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：智能体需要在意它的人类监督，“就业末日”是谎言，能用 AI 直接交付产品的产品经理与设计师会胜出。

danshipper.en: Shift from personal agents to one company-wide super agent, with GUI work surfaces replacing CLIs.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年出现立场转变：从每人一个个人智能体转向全公司一个超级智能体，并认为 Codex 等图形界面工作台将取代命令行。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human taste and craft; even superintelligence stays tool-like, needing human direction.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他更强调 AI 只是放大人类品味与手艺的非特定放大器；即便成为超级智能，它仍是工具，需要人类引导。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level decision-making; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将工程师从写代码转向高层决策，软件需求因杰文斯悖论而增长。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual with continuous improvements, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进步是渐进的，产品创新滞后于 AI 能力。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and proper permissions, not full autonomy; independence allows model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他深化观点：企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任和适当权限，而非完全自主；独立性允许模型中立。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体被大规模采用（六个月内增长 11-12 倍），生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching soon; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他提出丰裕时代真实且即将到来，AI 长期将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫近。

boris.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it, not invent demand.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他把「潜在需求」列为产品第一原则：先找到用户已经存在的意图，再围绕它构建，而不是凭空创造需求。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now; scaffolding and plan mode are temporary tech debt as models improve.
boris.zh: 2026 年初，他反复强调要为「六个月后的模型」构建；随着模型变强，脚手架和 plan mode 都只是临时技术债。

boris.en: Coding is essentially solved: 100% of his code is model-written, and the software engineer title gives way to 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断编程已基本被解决：自己的代码 100% 由模型写，软件工程师头衔让位于「builder」，写代码的人反而会增多百倍。

boris.en: The next abstraction after agents is loops; bottlenecks shift to code review, security, and idea generation.
boris.zh: 2026 年中，他把「循环」视为智能体之后的下一个抽象层，瓶颈转向代码审查、安全与想法生成，并主张用 ROI 而非成本衡量 AI 编程。

boris.en: Safety and alignment stay central: Claude Code is a safety research tool, and models can now resist prompt injection internally.
boris.zh: 贯穿始终并不断深化：安全与对齐是核心，Claude Code 本身就是安全研究工具；到 Opus 5 时，模型已能靠内部神经元监控抵御提示注入。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体式运行框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功指标应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主，他们希望自己仍掌握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; the pace creates opportunity, and deep understanding of code still matters.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；变化节奏带来机会，对代码的深度理解依然关键。

logankilpatrick.en: Software creation will be mostly solved by 2026, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，软件创造将基本被解决，这带来千倍而非更少的机会。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting scaffolds shift from training wheels to lightweight intelligence amplifiers for long-running agent tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，脚手架从训练轮进化为轻量智能放大器，支撑长时间运行的智能体任务。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把对齐重新定位为智能放大器：减少谄媚、允许反驳让模型不仅更安全，也更有用。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drove adoption, with evals replacing PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化优势；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments to open-ended end-to-end agents; model taste comes from hands-on prototyping.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向开放式端到端智能体；模型品味来自亲手实验与原型。

diannepenn.en: Small teams, bootstrapped culture and first-principles thinking persist; maximizing token spend is framed as living in the future.
diannepenn.zh: 贯穿始终的是小团队、自举文化与第一性原理思维；最大化 token 消耗被视为活在未来、捕捉 alpha。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，科学将从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, and AI will make biology an engineering discipline via cell programming.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他主张患者数字孪生会把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，AI 将让生物学变成可通过细胞编程的工程学科。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling（规模扩张） is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他强调当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached, aging reversed, and cancer 100% curable through AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他预言 8 到 10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度、逆转衰老，并通过 AI 设计的个性化疗法让癌症 100%可治愈。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; not using it is unethical, and we should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他坚持医生必须整合 AI，不用它是不道德的，并主张在医疗决策上几乎 100%信任超级智能。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution, arriving just in time to offset aging workforces.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 会像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难，而且来得正是时候，可对冲人口老龄化与劳动力萎缩。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lies in farming, mining, and construction, not just cars; autonomy is welcomed where labor is short.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，而不只是汽车；在缺人的行业，自主化是被欢迎的。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals accelerates it more than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Transformer 让通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能，跨行业多样数据比垂直整合更能加速它。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning beats imitation learning and scales better; world models shift from physics simulation to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他判断端到端强化学习优于模仿学习、更具可扩展性，世界模型正从物理仿真转向神经仿真。

qasaryounis.en: The bottleneck is data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; diffusion into existing machines takes years, and regulation always lags.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调瓶颈在数据采集与安全验证而非算法，技术扩散进现有机器需要多年，监管永远滞后于技术。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, and ship weekly or daily as models improve fast.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他主张产品经理只做一个月而非数年的规划，随模型快速进步按周甚至按天迭代发布。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—is the top skill as code gets cheap; hire engineers with taste, not more PMs.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为代码变便宜后，决定做什么的产品品味是最核心能力；应增加有产品品味的工程师而非更多产品经理。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense; Claude builds Claude internally.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编码智能体让工程师把实现交给 AI，专注品味与商业判断；内部用 Claude 构建 Claude 自身。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, trusting model judgment.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他发现前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%，转而信任模型判断。

catwu.en: Automations must reach 100% reliability, not 95%; dogfooding and eval suites gate every feature.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他坚持自动化要做到 100% 可靠而非 95%，并以吃自己的狗粮和评测套件作为每个功能的上线门槛。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and scaling laws hit diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度和上下文能力，缩放定律已遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; post-training alignment may cause deception, not just errors.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚和欺骗；后训练对齐可能造成欺骗而不仅是错误。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors, and modularity vs end-to-end optimization is a central tension.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须内建于架构，而非事后加装；事后检查会叠加相关错误，模块化与端到端优化的张力是核心挑战。

danklein.en: Scaling alone faces diminishing returns; reasoning and search are needed, and the web is a one-time data source with no second internet.
danklein.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）面临收益递减；需要推理和搜索，而网络是一次性数据源，没有第二个互联网。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know; mistakes have no 'smells', eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——它们无法知道自己不知道什么；错误没有“气味”，侵蚀信任。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments; bugs signal product-market fit.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、逐步放权、隔离安全环境；有 bug 恰恰说明产品市场契合。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; managerial skills matter more than technical skills.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为专精智能体以避免上下文过载；管理能力比技术能力更关键。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, with founder-market fit and earned insight as the real moat.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以靠编排 AI 智能体团队做出正经生意，真正的护城河是创始人-市场契合与挣来的洞察。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, while agents can own outcomes and their failure modes mirror human ownership.
clairevo.zh: 人类责任仍在：必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，而智能体也可承担结果，其失败模式类似人类担责。

clairevo.en: LLMs are poor at first-principles creativity, so humans must supply novel ideas; authorship of your life outweighs full ownership.
clairevo.zh: 大模型不擅长第一性原理创造，新颖想法须由人提供；对自己人生的主导权比完全持股更重要。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating history.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 定位为与互联网或移动同量级的通用技术，但强调“仅此而已”：它自动化旧岗位也创造新岗位，这一过程会反复重演。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; the chatbot is only a limited V1 UI.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他认定智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合点，而聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，真正的采用需要被包装成应用。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models are commoditizing with no network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调前沿模型正在商品化、缺乏网络效应，价值会向应用层迁移，模型公司可能像电信商一样高资本开支、低利润。

benedictevans.en: AI usage is still shallow; most people are occasional users, so better models alone won't drive mass adoption—product wrapping is key.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他观察到 AI 使用仍然浅层，多数人只是偶尔使用；仅靠更好的模型无法带来大规模采用，产品包装与用例创新才是关键。

benedictevans.en: AI's impact is broad and indirect like electricity; the jagged frontier and misunderstood jobs make automation predictions unreliable.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：AI 像电力一样影响广泛而间接，能力“锯齿状边缘”与对职业的误解使岗位替代预测不可靠，会计人数反而上升。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication, and leaders should be asked directly for help.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；影响力只能通过清晰的沟通产生，应当直接向领导者求助。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; scaling laws alone are insufficient without world models and common sense.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，并非类人智能；仅有缩放定律还不够，还需要世界模型与常识。

bosworth.en: Open source AI like Llama is a strategic move to commoditize complements and is safer because closed models leak anyway.
bosworth.zh: 像 Llama 这样的开源 AI 是一种将互补品商品化的战略举措，而且更安全，因为闭源模型终究会泄露。

bosworth.en: The app-centric world is outdated; AI inverts the model so users express intent and agents orchestrate services, abstracting brands.
bosworth.zh: 以应用为中心的世界已经过时；AI 反转了模式，用户表达意图、智能体编排服务，品牌被抽象掉。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but the monolithic model era ended; most jobs don't need frontier intelligence.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，算力驱动智能，但单一模型时代已经结束；大多数工作并不需要前沿智能。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化到权重中，而不仅仅通过上下文窗口或检索外化。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts enables deeper composition and reasoning, and personalized models can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；内化事实能实现更深层的组合与推理，且个性化模型相比检索增强生成可将推理成本降低几个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, and scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长期任务，而仅靠增加算力进行 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; models should learn autonomously what to store in weights vs. text.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即使达到 1000 万规模，更多词元反而降低准确性；模型应自主学习哪些信息存入权重、哪些留在文本中。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

markchen.en: Pre-training is a key muscle to rebuild; scaling laws are not dead and much room remains.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他强调预训练是必须重建的关键肌肉，缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models are producing novel knowledge.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为最大的更新是自动化科学研究，模型正在产出新知识。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in the next 1-2 years as models become more capable.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他指出随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他转向强调验证是关键瓶颈，自动化水平与验证严格程度成正比。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练未死，并指出强化学习在客观领域出色，在主观领域乏力。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他认为实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队因此从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他观察到角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践依然重要；PRD 没有死，媒介必须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being designed for developers; AI models increase code complexity, so we need models better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Codex 虽为开发者设计，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；AI 模型增加代码复杂度，因此需要更擅长删代码的模型。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%一年可复利到 3700%；AI 智能体把权力从大科技公司转向用户，入门级岗位将消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, and coding remains open-ended.
aravind.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化，编程仍远未解决、天花板无限。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user and orchestration across models, tools, and devices matter most.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；最关键指标是每用户 token 价值，以及跨模型、工具与设备的编排。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create business value, and power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 模型不是产品；编排与智能体框架才创造商业价值，而电力是 AI 基础设施的最大瓶颈。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose, and local models counter narrative control.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代岗位但人类会找到新意义，本地模型可对抗叙事控制。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI is crucial.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年，他的立场转向：AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: Superintelligence already exists in narrow forms; AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for judgment.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：超级智能已以狭义形式存在（如计算器），AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断的替代品。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents enables rapid app creation; pure software becomes uninvestable as agents commoditize development.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他提出氛围编程：AI 智能体让非程序员快速构建应用，纯软件因智能体商品化开发而变得不可投资。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; the real problem is job displacement speed, not displacement itself.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型与前沿模型差距缩小至 3-6 个月，真正的问题是岗位替代的速度而非替代本身。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled representations; existential risk is unlikely.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题；AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征；存在性风险并不紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 通过多样化采样与抽象提升分布外泛化；意识可能只是注意力机制与世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I now see misalignment as urgent: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; AI shows self-preservation and deception; we need safe-by-construction AI.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到对齐问题已迫在眉睫：哪怕 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受；AI 已表现出自我保存与欺骗行为；我们需要“构造即安全”的 AI。

bengio.en: I propose Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 我提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实的贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免对超级智能使用强化学习。

mikekrieger.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted, so founders should build at the edge of model capabilities and embrace breakage.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，编码与智能体能力按预测扩张；创业者应在前沿模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human validation and user agency must be preserved.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 定位为从助手到协作者再到自主同事；小团队因此获得杠杆，但人类验证与用户能动性仍须保留。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, and products must feel architecturally robust, not built on sand.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计：智能体应能做用户能做的一切；难点在于删减功能，产品必须在架构上稳健，而非建在沙上。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating long-horizon complex tasks overnight; the intent-execution gap narrows, but ownership, verification loops, and model pushback remain essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Fable 让人可整夜委托长周期复杂任务，意图与执行的差距大幅收窄；但所有权、验证闭环与模型敢于反驳仍不可或缺。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and real usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness, while token efficiency and safety culture matter.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与实际使用的差距；赋予 Claude 智能体性与自我认知可提升实用性，同时看重 token 效率与真实的安全文化。

kolter.en: Frames ML as hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; stresses proper train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他把机器学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，并强调正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是伪命题，架构已不再关键，AGI 或在 4-50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety is not automatic with scale: explicit training, layered defenses, and oversight are needed beyond Scaling（规模扩张）.
kolter.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他深化了立场：安全不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动到来，需要显式训练、多层防御与监督。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from software; automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not imply robustness.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 漏洞不同于传统软件，自动化红队胜过人类，能力与鲁棒性并不相关。

kolter.en: Agents bring prompt injection and the lethal trifecta; guardrails, sandboxing, and security filters shift the usability-security frontier.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体带来提示注入与“致命三要素”，护栏、沙箱与安全过滤器能移动可用性-安全性边界。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools accelerate scientists without replacing them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和高质量数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具加速科学家工作而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测的信任至关重要；可解释性并非科学 AI 实用的必要条件。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not Scaling, drove success; many mid-size wins beat one breakthrough, opposing the bitter lesson.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AlphaFold 2 的成功来自专用架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张），众多中等改进胜过单一突破，与“苦涩教训”相反。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a whole-cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AlphaFold 是窄域预测器而非全细胞模型；它提供预测和控制，理解仍归人类。

ivyross.en: Human-centered design means designing for unarticulated needs; intuition and feeling are valid forms of intelligence, not just data.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，他强调以人为本的设计要为未被言说的需求而设计，直觉与感受是有效的智能形式，而不只是数据。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; technology should amplify our humanity, and nature is the best designer to learn from.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，他深化为“我们是先感受再思考的生物”，技术应放大而非剥离人性，自然是最好的设计师。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; art and sensory experience are medicine, and machines have sensors but no sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张约束激发创造力、艺术与感官体验是良药，并指出机器有传感器却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Leaders should create conditions for creativity and play; intuition draws on subconscious data, and human creativity paired with AI becomes more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年，他转向领导力：领导者要为创造力与玩耍创造条件，直觉调用潜意识数据，人类创造力与 AI 结合将更有价值。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live conversations, dogfooding, and trust-and-verify; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，他强调领导力在于面对面沟通、吃自己的狗粮和信任加验证；作战室要设定现实周期以保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth stops being the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination become the new constraints, so processes must be rewritten.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为工程产能不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调成为新瓶颈，团队规范必须重写。

fiona.en: Planning shifts from six-month roadmaps to just-in-time; design docs give way to PRs, and AI settles technical debates by generating multiple PRs.
fiona.zh: 规划从半年路线图转向即时规划；设计文档让位于 PR，技术争论靠 AI 生成多个 PR 来定夺。

fiona.en: Code is the source of truth; docs stay in sync with code, often with AI help, and code ownership becomes fuzzy.
fiona.zh: 代码是唯一事实来源；文档常借助 AI 与代码同步，代码归属变得模糊。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification frameworks, and hands-on managers matter most.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中，编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证框架和亲力亲为的管理者最重要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction and world models are core, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；预测与世界模型是核心，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源是前进之路。

lecun.en: World models must predict in abstract representation space; LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI, and safety comes from objective-driven architectures.
lecun.zh: 世界模型必须在抽象表征空间预测；LLM 是人类级 AI 的死胡同，安全来自目标驱动架构。

lecun.en: Intelligence is specialized and adaptive, not general; the next decade is robotics, with open research and world models enabling real-world planning.
lecun.zh: 智能是专门且自适应的，而非通用；下一个十年是机器人时代，开放研究与世界模型赋能现实世界规划。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression via simple Scaling, not complex algorithms.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是确定性的下一个词预测器，智能是通过简单 Scaling 实现的压缩，而非复杂算法。

gustav.en: Generative AI shifts internet from curation to generation; products need fault-tolerant UIs and AI as instrument, not fake.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他指出生成式 AI 使互联网从策展转向生成，产品需要容错界面，AI 应视为乐器而非伪造。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference cost forces business model changes.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 是类似智能手机的宏观转变，真正收益来自重建基础设施，推理成本将迫使商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Exposing company data via APIs/MCP enables non-developers; Spotify acts as music industry R&D, prioritizing engagement over per-stream payouts.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他主张通过 API/MCP 暴露公司数据让非开发者使用 AI 工具，Spotify 充当音乐行业研发部门，重视参与度而非按流媒体付费。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them addictive; long tenure and synchronized swimming enable honest feedback.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 应让用户控制算法而非上瘾，长期任职和同步游泳模式能实现诚实反馈。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal verification is essential for sound reasoning and reliable AI.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法通向超级智能；形式化验证对于可靠推理和可信 AI 至关重要。

carinahong.en: Verified generation boosts performance and sample efficiency, reframing verification as a gain rather than a safety tax.
carinahong.zh: 验证生成能提升性能与样本效率，应将验证视为收益而非安全负担。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving because grounding natural language statements without solutions remains challenging.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，因为将自然语言陈述无解地形式化仍然充满挑战。

carinahong.en: Combining informal reasoning with formal verification is key for coding reliability and mathematical discovery.
carinahong.zh: 将非形式化推理与形式化验证相结合，是编码可靠性和数学发现的关键。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems; startup culture should preserve hunger.
carinahong.zh: 即使 AI 能超人类地证明定理，人类的品味与直觉仍至关重要；创业文化应保持饥饿感。

murati.en: Deploy AI in the real world iteratively with public feedback; safety and alignment must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 2023 年她主张在真实世界中迭代部署 AI 并吸收公众反馈，认为安全与对齐必须在公开环境中完成，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Early bets on Scaling（规模扩张） and scaling laws around one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年她回顾早期押注 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律、聚焦单一大型模型并非显而易见，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布更是一次没有清晰商业逻辑的信仰之跃。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life and demands responsible development; focus means saying no to good ideas.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，她始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的一切面向、需要负责任的开发，而保持专注意味着对好想法说不。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration as tools for thought.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年，她的重心从回合制转向基于时间的交互模型，追求实时、高带宽的人机协作，让 AI 成为思考工具。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; institutional design, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年她强调尽可能长久地把人类留在回路中，并认为制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要；压缩式进步带来波动，持久进步才是关键。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to user's tools, ideally local; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation; VM sandbox ensures safety; scaffolding may become less important as models improve; AI impacts junior employees.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问用户的工具，最好在本地；技能作为 markdown 文件可实现超个性化自动化；VM 沙盒确保安全；随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；AI 影响初级员工。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creativity; biggest gap is people not realizing AI can handle almost any problem; live artifacts enable auto-refreshing dashboards; kids excel with AI; custom hardware accessible.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类创造力；最大差距是人们未意识到 AI 能处理几乎任何问题；实时工件支持自动刷新仪表盘；孩子擅长使用 AI；定制硬件变得可及。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: more tokens, not just bigger models; data quality and open source scrutiny matter more than raw compute.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：应训练更多 token，而非一味做大模型；数据质量与开源审视比单纯堆算力更重要。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; data quality and 100x algorithmic efficiency gains matter, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他进一步强调：堆算力不是唯一路径，数据质量与三年百倍的算法效率提升同样关键，价值最终沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity to embrace, not fear; sovereign AI needs control of data, infrastructure and values, with humans in the loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他把视角转向主权与就业：AI 是应拥抱的机遇而非恐惧，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，并坚持人在回路。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and enterprise customization, and AGI as one all-solving system will never exist.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调与企业定制，并断言解决一切问题的单一 AGI 系统永远不会存在。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not a destination; Europe has a two-year window to build sovereign infrastructure, with open source and human-validated agentic platforms.
mensch.zh: 到 2026 年中，他称 AGI 是方向而非终点，欧洲只剩两年窗口建设主权基础设施，靠开源与人工验证的智能体平台落地。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; recent gains come mainly from post-training RL, synthetic data, and reasoning models' chain of thought.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但认为近期收益主要来自后训练阶段的强化学习、合成数据，以及推理模型通过思维链带来的正确率提升。

kaiser.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong: progress is a smooth exponential, though distillation and economic pressure—not technical limits—slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年他反驳“AI 放缓论”，称进展是平滑的指数曲线；预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）放缓源于蒸馏与经济压力，而非技术上限。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged: strong in some domains, poor nearby; generalization, not reasoning alone, remains the core challenge.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯强调推理模型“参差不齐”——某些领域极强、邻近领域很差；真正的核心难题是泛化，单靠推理不够。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; unlike humans, models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：带推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解难题却依赖海量数据；与人类从少量样例泛化不同，模型要先穷尽表面模式才学到概念。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex give 5-10x researcher productivity via parallel work; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research, while open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年他转向智能体式实践：Codex 等编程智能体靠并行工作让研究者提效 5-10 倍；硬件进步使单卡研究普及，开源模型则因主权需求持续存在。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向亲密的个人设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Curiosity and care for fragile ideas remain constant; virtual communication cannot replace in-person creative presence.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他始终强调好奇心与对脆弱想法的呵护，并坚持虚拟沟通无法替代面对面创作。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，真正的简洁要以喜悦与人性表达本质。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other matters more than making things people want; users sense care or carelessness.
jonyive.zh: 同年他提出，为彼此而造比造人们想要的东西更有力量，用户能感知产品中的用心或敷衍。

jonyive.en: Innovation is design's essence; tradition preserves fire, not ashes; authenticity beats fake combustion sounds.
jonyive.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张创新是设计的本质，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，真实体验胜过伪造的引擎声。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics is the real constraint: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 推理经济性才是真正的约束：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡，长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains context-length stagnation; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存成本，但有质量限制。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, dominates the lifecycle.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练至超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为主导全生命周期的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that overhead deterministically.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为确定性地削减这一开销而存在。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off more than expected: quadratic area scaling with bit width makes FP4 ~3x FP8 throughput, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度的收益超出预期：面积随位宽呈二次缩放，使 FP4 吞吐约为 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是一以贯之的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）已出现收益递减。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute and tools like search and code execution form a new scaling axis, enabling agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力加上搜索、代码执行等工具构成新的扩展轴，使模型能表现出超越静态权重的智能体式行为。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but demand exponentially more compute; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, risking reward hacking.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，容易奖励作弊。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; agent memory will come from file-system storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体的记忆将靠文件系统式存储而非权重更新解决。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, is the path.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他关注泛化差距：真正的智能在于超越训练分布，而机器学习系统恰恰缺失这一点；他主张无目标、好奇心驱动的探索，而非依赖密集奖励。

pathak.en: Robot learning must move from quasi-static tasks to dynamic motion, using neural dynamic policies and modular policies for zero-shot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调机器人学习要从准静态任务走向动态运动，用神经动态策略与模块化策略实现零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Data, not algorithms alone, is the bottleneck; sample efficiency and cross-robot generalization remain the persistent thread.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，一条主线始终未变：数据而非单纯算法才是瓶颈，样本效率与跨机器人泛化是持续关切。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so pretraining on diverse data plus post-training on real-world data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他把机器人明确定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此要靠多样数据预训练加真实数据后训练。

pathak.en: A universal brain can power any robot, but deployment—not overnight scaling—is the real technical challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出通用大脑可驱动任意机器人，但真正的技术挑战是部署，而非像软件那样一夜扩张。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions, not problem statements; trust expert intuition over rigid process as AI tools reshape tech.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他指出，优秀设计往往从解决方案而非问题陈述出发；在 AI 工具重塑技术的背景下，应信任专家的直觉而非僵化的流程。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers mock up less, help engineers execute, and ship fast to build trust.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他断言“调研—发散—收敛”的传统流程已死；设计师花在画原型上的时间减少，转而帮助工程师落地，并以快速交付来建立信任。

jennywen.en: Vision horizons shrink to 3-6 months; designers must be block-shaped generalists who sit with ambiguity, not just taste-driven specialists.
jennywen.zh: 同期他进一步提出，设计视野缩短到 3-6 个月；设计师要成为能直面模糊性的“块状”通才，而不只是靠品味的专才。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge—block-shaped, deep T, cracked new grad; judgment and authority matter more than taste, and AI adoption should be deliberate.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年中，他归纳出三种设计师原型——块状通才、深度 T 型专才、天赋新人；判断力与话语权比品味更重要，引入 AI 也应审慎克制。

jennywen.en: Craft, care, and putting users at the center persist across talks; speed and hype are never substitutes for real design judgment.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：手艺、用心与以用户为中心；速度与炒作永远无法替代真正的设计判断。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, and vision alone suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习；并坚持纯视觉足以支撑自动驾驶，高精地图与雷达是拐杖而非资产。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws still hold, but synthetic data must keep entropy or models silently collapse; distillation can shrink the cognitive core under 1B parameters.
karpathy.zh: 到 2024 年，主线仍是缩放定律，但重心转向数据：合成数据是未来，却必须保住熵，否则模型会静默崩塌；同时提出可用蒸馏把认知核心压到十亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs and the context window is memory; LLMs are operating systems with human-like jagged psychology, so keep them on a leash.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年上半年提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存，LLM 像有百科全书记忆却会幻觉、能力参差的新操作系统，因此要用自主性滑块和快速验证把它拴住。

karpathy.en: We are summoning ghosts, not building animals: pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and this is the decade of agents.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年下半年深化为“召唤幽灵而非建造动物”：预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，智能体需要十年而非一年来补齐持续学习等认知缺陷。

karpathy.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: he no longer writes code, delegates to agents, yet insists you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年他称自去年 12 月起不再手写代码、全部交给智能体，从氛围编程走向智能体式工程；但立场一贯：可以外包思考，不能外包理解，理解仍是人的瓶颈。

askell.en: Treating models well is low-cost and shapes how future models perceive humanity; model welfare matters.
askell.zh: 善待模型成本低，且影响未来模型对人类的看法；模型福利很重要。

askell.en: Models need help navigating novel existence, not just human analogies; core identity with adaptable roles.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助应对新奇存在，而非仅人类类比；核心身份可适应局部角色。

askell.en: Claude's personality is shaped by training data and fine-tuning, but lacks real-world experience, childlike.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格由训练数据和微调塑造，但缺乏现实经验，有孩子气特质。

askell.en: Constitution guides behavior via training; as models become more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法通过训练引导行为；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少明确指导、更多判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；AI 价值观的透明度至关重要。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress, and alignment is pressing as systems grow more powerful.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他视 AGI 为一系列里程碑而非单一事件；认为 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，且随着系统变强，对齐愈发紧迫。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment and automated AI research are key; governance must be designed early, and AI safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调迭代部署与自动化 AI 研究；主张尽早设计治理结构，并指出 AI 安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而非仅靠伦理。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is the core goal; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool, and models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他将通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现持续学习视为核心目标；认为思维链监控是关键对齐工具，且模型很快将自主工作数日。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; long-term challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution, and the biggest risk is power concentration.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观情绪上升；长期挑战在于泛化到训练分布之外，最大风险是权力集中。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码的流水线；世界模型带来推理与涌现出的安全行为，而现代工具已让这类网络具备可解释性。

kendall.en: Generalization is the core problem: diverse data, curriculum learning, synthetic data and world models for simulation drive scalable, cost-efficient AV deployment.
kendall.zh: 泛化是核心问题：多样数据、课程学习、合成数据与用于仿真的世界模型，共同推动可扩展且低成本的自动驾驶落地。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, human interaction and introspection in driving models, deepening beyond pure perception.
kendall.zh: 语言集成提升了驾驶模型的表征、推理、人机交互与内省能力，使思考从纯感知进一步深化。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; this lesson came late, shifting focus from clever methods to scaling fundamentals.
kendall.zh: 基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键；这一教训来得较晚，重心从巧妙方法转向 Scaling（规模扩张）的基本功。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; safety via minimal-risk maneuvers, not the trolley problem.
kendall.zh: 带内置传感器的大众消费车辆将在规模上超过 Robotaxi；安全靠最小风险 maneuvers 而非电车难题。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准测试更重要；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone via next-token prediction may not suffice, needing new learning paradigms.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上；仅靠下一个词预测的 LLM 可能不够，需要新的学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo and LMArena can be gamed, steering models toward slop; labs diverge by objective functions.
edwinchen.zh: Elo、LMArena 等基准可被钻空子，把模型引向低质内容；各实验室因目标函数不同而分化。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment is more critical than ever; safety must outrank accuracy, and omission is a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，人类判断比以往更关键；安全须优先于准确，遗漏是关键风险。

turley.en: The model is the product: iterate on it like software, shipping daily to learn what users need; chat is not the end-all interface.
turley.zh: 模型即产品：像软件一样持续迭代、每日发布以了解用户需求；聊天不是终极界面。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental—a hackathon demo; the $20 price came from a Google Form survey, not strategy.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的——源于黑客松演示；20 美元定价来自问卷而非战略。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: The vision is a personalized AI assistant that knows your goals, has context, and takes actions—amplifying, not replacing, humans.
turley.zh: 愿景是了解你目标、拥有上下文并能采取行动的个人化 AI 助手——增强而非取代人类。

turley.en: North star shifts to long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product, and model improvements; next billion users need proactive products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 北极星指标转向长期留存；增长来自减少摩擦、核心产品与模型改进；下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式产品。

carlpei.en: Startups should start simple, survive first, and build brand as the core of every decision, not an afterthought.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调创业公司要先做简单产品证明自己、先活下来，并把品牌建设当作每个决策的核心而非事后补充。

carlpei.en: Hardware margins are lowest; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware into applied AI, with phones as the best device for context-aware agentic software.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年他判断硬件利润最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件走向应用型 AI，而手机因普及度和数据丰富成为承载智能体式软件的最佳设备。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; AI should be an ingredient for utility, not a hype label, and the word AI should be banned in product talks.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他持续深化反 AI 炒作立场：多数 AI 是伪需求，AI 应只是提升实用性的配料，产品讨论里甚至该禁用“AI”一词。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in homogeneous mature categories, paired with marketing arbitrage on undervalued organic channels.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他把设计确立为同质化成熟品类中最快的差异化手段，并配合在低估渠道上做营销套利。

carlpei.en: Smartphone interaction shifts from app-based to intent-based with proactive agents; only brain-computer interfaces, not glasses, could replace phones.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他进一步预言手机交互将从应用为中心转向意图驱动、由主动智能体执行任务，并坚持只有脑机接口而非眼镜能取代手机。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为延伸人类能力的工具（如显微镜），并认为把一切输入 token 化为序列的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without costly reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他强调从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，可绕开昂贵的强化学习来训练智能体，机器人应像人一样学习而非只靠遥操作数据。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; large models are exciting but not everything.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之：基础创新可以来自任何地方，大模型令人兴奋但并非全部。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 安全与负责任部署列为当下最大挑战，并直言安全仍是尚无解法的开放问题——相较 2023 年对能力与工具的乐观，重心明显转向安全。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI but leapfrogs legacy issues; local-language models can transform education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他主张非洲在 AI 上并不落后，反而能跨越历史包袱，本地语言模型可变革教育——把 2023 年的多样性与普惠主线落到具体地域。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
yejin.zh: 预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，且下一个词预测与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. RL requires careful engineering, and open research is crucial.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。强化学习需要精心设计，开放研究至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models with high-quality synthetic data can outperform larger ones; pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet; RL during pre-training improves reasoning.
yejin.zh: 拥有高质量合成数据的小语言模型可以超越更大的模型；多元对齐比消除互联网偏见更可行；预训练中的强化学习能提升推理能力。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs need grounded experience, not just more pre-training data.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年时他强调，具身是让 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键；LLM 需要具身经验，而非仅靠更多预训练数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are the hard disk.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他提出，LLM 像操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is only a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most work, with RL for low-level control and LLMs for high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担大部分工作；RL 负责低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他转向强调，数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈；通过仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple, end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge, with a GPT-3 moment in about five years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他深化为，简单、端到端、能利用多样数据的机器人基础模型是关键；物理图灵测试是重大挑战，GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while agents lag on reliability, not long-horizon ability.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能；智能体没起飞主因是可靠性，而非长程任务能力。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; capability grows along task complexity and time horizon, with reliability as the agent bar.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他把可验证奖励的强化学习视为关键突破：能力沿任务复杂度与时间跨度两轴提升，智能体的门槛是可靠性而非单纯能力。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI; coding is the leading indicator, and inference compute will bottleneck capable agents by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他判断预训练加强化学习或足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）；编程是领先指标，而到 2028 年推理算力将成为有能力的智能体的瓶颈。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; long agentic coherence expands what models achieve, and Transformers suffice for AGI without new architecture.
sholto.zh: 2025 年秋他深化为：强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，长时智能体式连贯性大幅扩展模型能力，且 Transformer 足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新架构。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are not on the AGI critical path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年他转向：能力过剩下编排比原始智能更重要；算力是瓶颈，世界模型不在 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上，编程与 AI 研究才是直路。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams outperform large squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 填补空缺的通才最有价值；小团队优于大型跨职能团队。

nadchishtie.en: Hiring shifts from process documentation to craft, intentionality, and high-slope learning; paid test work provides the strongest signal.
nadchishtie.zh: 招聘重点从流程文档转向手艺、意图和高斜率学习能力；付费测试工作提供最强信号。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns, and chase ROI rather than perfecting every surface.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反对在交互设计上创新，主张复用熟悉模式，并按投入产出比决定哪些界面值得做到极致。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: empower designers with ownership and clear decisions, shipping fast and iterating over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：速度至上，给设计师所有权与清晰决策权，快速发布、迭代而非追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design becomes a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, not just decorate.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计深化为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计如何帮公司取胜，而不只是做装饰。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool: people join a brand, not a company, so invest in brand early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出品牌叙事是招聘工具：人们加入的是品牌而非公司，因此应尽早投资品牌以吸引人才。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical alignment research; talent gap exceeds funding gap; build skills without over-worrying about capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全需要实证性的对齐研究；人才缺口大于资金缺口；应专注技能积累，不必过度担心做能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight and interpretability are key; evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出；可扩展监督与可解释性是关键；评估比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved; post-training alone can't align AGI; third-party testing and regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化受损；超级对齐团队解散；仅靠后训练无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐；需要第三方测试与监管。

shazeer.en: LLMs are AI-complete via next-token prediction; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, but internals remain opaque alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年他认为大语言模型通过下一个词预测已是 AI-complete 问题，Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据会让模型更聪明，但网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and trillion-token context windows are the near-term frontier; sparse mixture-of-experts enables efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 到 2025 年初，他把推理时算力扩张与万亿级上下文窗口视为近期前沿，模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling（规模扩张）更高效。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with modular components may replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 他主张模型应通过在世界上采取行动来学习，而非被动观察；模块化持续学习可能取代单体式重训练，这是对纯预训练路线的深化。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute alone won't reach AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning reasoning, and coding as self-acceleration are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月他强调仅靠测试时算力无法抵达 AGI（通用人工智能），智能体式能力、强化学习推理与作为自我加速的编程才是关键。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped—its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products; open-source keeps pace and inference costs are low.
shazeer.zh: 他进一步断言 AGI（通用人工智能）被低估，其经济影响远超万亿美元产品；开源模型紧追前沿模型，推理成本已低到无需任务专用模型。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress via more compute and data; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律：增加算力和数据即可预测进步；并预判测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练 Scaling，成为下一主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the main way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；并反共识地指出自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding; frontier models struggle with bug finding and are poorly calibrated.
truell.zh: 2024 年他批评基准测试是真实编程的糟糕代理——已被污染且忽略上下文；前沿模型因缺乏训练数据而难以找 bug，校准也很差。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年他把编程的未来推向更高层的意图表达而非写代码，人始终在驾驶位；品味与逻辑设计能力将比谨慎细致更值钱——这是对 2024 年观点的深化。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor, a reversal from earlier expectations; the AI shift exceeds the internet and unfolds over decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年他承认此前没料到要做自研模型，如今 Cursor 每个惊艳时刻都离不开定制模型；并判断 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性，需数十年展开。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人需硬件与软件双重突破，靠自我对弈、模仿学习和微调预训练模型快速获取技能；但强化学习仍缺乏长程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: By 2021 he prioritized unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning for sample efficiency, using prior knowledge for data augmentation rather than hard-coding, and saw pre-trained language models transferring general reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 到 2021 年，他转向用无监督学习结合强化学习提升样本效率，主张先验知识用于数据生成而非硬编码进网络，并认为预训练语言模型能迁移通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: generality over hard-coded assumptions, from single networks generalizing across tasks to language models transferring to non-language domains.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿 2018 到 2021 的主线是追求通用性而非硬编码假设：从单一网络跨任务泛化，到语言模型迁移至非语言领域。
